caption:
Can a new customer understand your product in ten seconds? ⏱️

This is a simple exercise, not a research claim: open your product page on a phone, look at it for about ten seconds, then write down what you remember. Product, customer, price, proof, delivery and the next step should all be easy to spot.

Swipe for the six things a first view should show, plus a hypothetical before and after.

💬 Which of the six is missing on your page? Tell us in the comments.
